forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,45 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+depends_on:
+- 01KYVYR4WAM57CVTWFZS948ZPF
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: d780
+title: Extend _partials/findings-are-requirements to the remaining code-touching agents and skills
+---
+# Problem
+
+`builtin/_partials/findings-are-requirements.md` ships the one rule-obedience stance (task `^s948zpf`). It reaches 7 files: the implementer, reviewer, tester, and committer agents, and the implement, finish, and review skills.
+
+Other agents and skills also write or judge code and do not get the stance:
+
+- `builtin/agents/double-check/AGENT.md` — the largest miss. It WRITES findings, so the "never write nit, minor, cosmetic, polish, pedantry, or churn" rule applies to it most of all.
+- `builtin/agents/default/AGENT.md`
+- `builtin/agents/general-purpose/AGENT.md`
+- `builtin/skills/kanban/SKILL.md` — the general-purpose pick-up-a-card skill, the sibling of `implement`.
+- `builtin/skills/tdd/SKILL.md`
+- `builtin/skills/test/SKILL.md`
+
+# Blocker to resolve first
+
+`builtin/agents/double-check/AGENT.md` says to list findings "severity-ranked (highest first)". The partial says "There is no severity tier. Every finding is mandatory." These disagree. Decide which is correct before you add the include there:
+
+- Ranking findings by severity for READING ORDER does not have to mean some findings are optional. If that is the intent, reword the double-check agent so the order is presentation only.
+- If a severity tier is real for double-check, the partial and the double-check agent need separate stances, and this card must say why.
+
+Do not add the include to `double-check` and leave the contradiction in place.
+
+# Changes
+
+1. Resolve the `double-check` severity contradiction above.
+2. Add `{% include "_partials/findings-are-requirements" %}` to each file the decision covers.
+3. Add each new file to the guard lists: `COVERED_AGENTS` / `COVERED_SKILLS` in `crates/mirdan/tests/findings_are_requirements_coverage.rs` and `COVERED_SKILLS` in `crates/swissarmyhammer-skills/tests/findings_are_requirements_guidance.rs`.
+4. Check the rendered heading level per file. The partial emits `### Findings Are Requirements`, so put the include where that h3 does not read as a child of an unrelated `##` section.
+
+# Acceptance
+
+- `cargo nextest run -E 'rdeps(swissarmyhammer-skills) or rdeps(swissarmyhammer-agents)'` passes.
+- The guard tests list every covered agent and skill, and each one goes RED when its include is removed.
+- No builtin file states a severity tier that the partial denies.
+
+#review
\ No newline at end of file
